Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

collection.description: A carver sets a row of shark teeth along a wooden blade for cutting fiber and cleaning fish.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (Name1), a carver, sets a row of shark teeth along a wooden blade for cutting fiber and cleaning fish. When an apprentice asks whether it is a tool or a weapon, the carver says it depends on whose hands hold it, and why.
